To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the global economy is changing, that technological literacy education must change to meet the demands of the emerging global economy, that technological literacy should be defined as the ability to use, and to create and modify, information and communication technologies, that this new conception of technological literacy must be developed in a manner that accounts for the global nature of the economy and the global network society, and that the new definition must be developed in such a way that it can be implemented by all nations in a manner that is culturally appropriate
The global network era has changed the nature of technological literacy.

the global network society is characterized by: 1) the emergence and widespread use of network technologies, 2) a new global economy that is based on the exchange of knowledge and information, and 3) a new form of social organization based on the use of network technologies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the relationship between technological literacy and globalization in the networked society.
how to prepare students to participate in the global network society.
the development of technological literacy for a global society that is increasingly networked.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the technological literacy of the future must be a literacy of networked digital technologies.

the global network era requires a new conception of technological literacy that is based on a new conception of the nature and role of technology and that is designed to prepare students for the new economy and new forms of work.
a new conception of technological literacy is needed to meet the challenges of the global network era.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the technological literacy education must prepare students to become global citizens, and to be able to participate in the global network society as active, creative and critical citizens.
we have tried to develop an approach to technological literacy education that is based on a new conception of technological literacy that is grounded in the emerging global network era.

technological literacy education should focus on helping students develop a critical understanding of the ways computer technologies are being used to shape the world around them and to help them develop skills for using these technologies to create their own visions of the world they want to live in.
The main takeaway from our work is that
technological literacy is a necessary component of the education of all students in the global network society.

the global network society is characterized by a new form of social organization that is based on the use of networked technologies to coordinate the activities of people and organizations around the globe.
technological literacy is not simply about learning to use technologies; rather, it is about learning to be an active, critical, and reflective participant in the emerging global network era.
